_comment: The three M0 reference models. The key is the llama-server --alias, the OpenCode model key
(--model llama/<key>, config/opencode.json) and the ognivo profile id.
The llama-server flags come from <ognivo_repo>/<profile> [server].recommended_flags, with
--chat-template-file made absolute (scripts/llama_cmd.py). agent_timeout_s is the per-task
agent budget used by run-suite.sh unless --timeout or task.json agent_timeout_s say otherwise,
equal decode capacity (owner's decision 2026-10-30): 480 s x ~116 tok/s ~ 56K tokens for the MoE models, 1500 s x ~41 tok/s ~ 61K for the dense Qwen3.8 (900 s gave it only ~37K).
